title: virtlab configuration
description: Declarative configuration for one virtlab lab. Save the file as config.yaml on the Workstation.

clusterName.description: Lab and OpenShift cluster name. Must be a lower-case RFC 1123 label of 1-32 characters. virtlab uses this name for Host directories, libvirt objects, and DNS names.

baseDomain.description: Base DNS domain of the cluster. Must be a valid RFC 1123 domain with at least one dot. Each label is 1-63 characters. The top-level label must not be all numeric.

ocpVersion.description: OpenShift version. Use MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH form, for example 4.22.0. This release supports Y-streams 4.20, 4.21, and 4.22.

preset.description: Cluster topology preset. sno uses one Control Plane Node. compact uses three Control Plane Nodes. ha uses three Control Plane Nodes and two Worker Nodes.

hostSsh.description: SSH settings for the remote Host hypervisor.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the Host. The Workstation must reach it over SSH.

user.description: SSH user on the Host. Default: root.

publicKeyFile.description: Path to the SSH public key on the Workstation. Tilde (~) expands to the home directory. The file must exist, be non-empty, and contain an OpenSSH public key. virtlab installs this key on the Host and injects it into the Nodes for console access.

pullSecretFile.description: Path to the Red Hat OpenShift pull secret on the Workstation. Tilde (~) expands to the home directory. If absent, virtlab tries to retrieve the pull secret with the ocm CLI. The file must be valid JSON with an auths section.

network.description: Settings for the isolated Lab Network.

name.description: Name of the Lab Network. Default: <clusterName>-net. The libvirt bridge device name is managed automatically and cannot be set here.

cidr.description: IPv4 subnet for the Lab Network in CIDR notation. An explicit value gives stable VIPs. If absent, the Host allocates the lowest free 192.168.X.0/24 subnet, starting at X=100.

gatewayIp.description: Not permitted. virtlab always derives the gateway as the first host address of network.cidr.

apiVip.description: API VIP, published as api and api-int. Default: network address offset .5. Used by compact and ha only. In sno, the single Node serves the API.

ingressVip.description: Ingress VIP for the cluster's own keepalived. Default: network address offset .6. Used by compact and ha only.

ingressLbVip.description: Ingress Load Balancer VIP, the answer for *.apps.<clusterName>.<baseDomain>. Default: network address offset .7. Used by compact and ha only.

controlPlaneOverrides.description: Optional per-node hardware overrides for every Control Plane Node. An absent field keeps the preset value.

workerOverrides.description: Optional per-node hardware overrides for every Worker Node. Applies to ha only. In sno, virtlab ignores this object and prints a warning. In compact, it has no effect.

memoryMib.description: RAM per Node in MiB. For example, 16384 is 16 GiB.

diskGib.description: Single root disk size per Node in GiB. Cannot be combined with disks.

disks.description: Ordered list of disks per Node. The first entry is the root OS disk (/dev/vda); additional entries attach as /dev/vdb, /dev/vdc, and so on. Cannot be combined with diskGib.
